subject: general
question: Soparrkar and the logo of his worldwide initiative ‘Dance for a Cause’ are being printed on an official postage stamp issued by the _______________ government.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Bhutan__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Soparrkar and the logo **of his worldwide initiative **‘Dance for a Cause’ **are being printed on an** official postage stamp **issued by the **Bhutan government.**
 
• This recognition of Soparrkar and his initiative "Dance for a Cause" through the issuance of an official postage stamp by the Bhutan government is a notable acknowledgment of their contribution to the world of dance and their philanthropic endeavors.
 
• The **decision to feature **Soparrkar and his initiative on a postage stamp signifies their significant impact and influence, both within Bhutan and globally.
 
• It showcases the government's appreciation for their efforts in promoting dance as a form of expression and their commitment to social causes.
 
• Furthermore, being featured on a postage stamp adds prestige and visibility to Soparrkar's work, as stamps are often considered symbols of honor and recognition.
 
• It also serves as a means of promoting their cause to a wider audience, as stamps are circulated through mail services and can reach people across different regions and demographics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sandip Soparrkar** is an acclaimed Indian Latin and ballroom dancer, renowned TEDx speaker, and scholar with a doctorate in **World Mythology Folklore from the Pacifica Graduate Institute** in the United States.
 
• He holds an Honorary Doctorate in Performing Arts from The National American University. His remarkable contributions to the field of dance and culture have earned him numerous accolades, including three National Excellence Awards and one National Achievement Award bestowed upon him by the Government of India.
 
• Soparrkar's endeavors have also been recognized internationally, as he has been honored with the Rabindranath Tagore Literary Prize for Social Achievement. Furthermore, his dedication to the arts has been acknowledged with prestigious awards such as the Bharat Gaurav Samaan presented by the Ministry of Culture at The House of Lords in London, UK.
 
• He is a recipient of the esteemed Shakti Samman, symbolized by a sword, conferred upon him by the Ministry of Culture, Government of India.
